messages:
Maria (platform): Heads up — we just ingested a second spike of late events from mobile (mostly join events). I want to propose a targeted batch reprocess for the 2026-03-09 00:00-06:00 window. Need alignment on: priority gating (tenant vs global), quota enforcement, and console UX for kicking off the job.
Sanjay: Are these reorders / duplicates or truly new keys?
Alex: Mostly joins that arrive after user-device-clock drift reconciles, so new rows for aggregates we consider final. Dedupe window (48h) already missed a chunk.
Olivia: If we run a wide streaming replay we will hit per-tenant compute caps and blow cross-account quotas. Prefer a targeted batch lane with per-tenant budget.
Ryan (console): For UX — we should surface estimated token-hours and a small sample diff preview before confirm. Also a modal to pick 'priority lane' (normal / premium / offline) + rollback plan.
DevEx: Can we show a small sample of the affected aggregates and their percent delta? That helped QE last time.
Maria (platform): Good call. Propose flow: 1) dry-run into delta prefixes (no swap), 2) diff sample + cost estimate, 3) operator confirm, 4) swap under a short maintenance flag. Also auto-block if a route has an active rollout flag.
Alex: We already have route metadata field "drain-mode" and rollout tags on /internal/routes API. Could use that to automatically pause reprocess for routes currently in canary.
Sanjay: Quota enforcement idea: each tenant gets a reprocess_budget (token-hours) and reprocess requests consume from it. Global priority-lane has circuit-breaker if global_commit_hours > X. Propose threshold at 75% of reserved capacity to avoid SLA impact.
Olivia: Agree on per-tenant budgets. Also need a fair-share scheduler so small tenants aren't starved by a single giant replay.
Ryan (console): UX bits: add estimated runtime and a cost slider that can throttle concurrency (e.g., target rps or token/hr) with live ETA update.
Maria (platform): Ops safety — do not swap aggregates in place until we run a diff QC. Write to telemetry.delta_{window} and then atomic swap.
Alex: Implementation sketch (internal API):
```
POST /internal/reprocess 
{
  "window_start": "2026-03-09T00:00:00Z",
  "window_end": "2026-03-09T06:00:00Z",
  "priority_lane": "premium",
  "per_tenant_budget": {"tenant_123": 1200},
  "dry_run": true
}
```
ops-bot: scheduled job created: reproc-20260309-0000 id=rp-42 status=queued (triggered by Maria) :white_check_mark:
Sanjay: For dedupe, we need deterministic idempotency key generation across original ingest + reprocess. We should reuse ingest-pk v2 function. Otherwise we get double-counts.
Olivia: Also warn data-owners: mobile-team and joins-team. We should add an optional notify_emails param so owners get a preflight note.
DevEx: Minimal console preview mock: show top 10 changed metrics, sample rows (before/after), and a slider for concurrency. Can prototype in the staging console within a day.
Ryan (console): I'll add a small banner: "Dry-run results saved to s3://telemetry/deltas/rp-42/* — review before swap" and a quick-check button that runs the diff job.
Maria (platform): One other constraint: prevent overlapping reprocesses for same shard range. Lock shards at scheduling time. If a new request touches locked shards, it should be queued or rejected.
Alex: We'll implement shard locks in reproc-coordinator. Lock TTL = estimated_runtime * 1.5. Add admin override for emergency backfills.
Sanjay: Monitoring: add a per-job metric reproc_token_hours_consumed and alert if job > expected*1.5. Also emit per-tenant consumption so billing/safety can act.
ops-bot: note: reproc-20260309-0000 moved to dry-run queue (rp-42).
Olivia: Security / compliance: ensure reprocess writes to the same encryption policy and that KMS keys are in scope for private deployments.
Maria (platform): Action items: Maria - coordinate preflight notice to data owners and confirm sample diffs; Alex - implement idempotent pk + shard lock; Ryan - console preview modal + cost slider prototype; Sanjay - quota/circuit-breaker config proposal and alerts; Olivia - tenant-budget enforcement logic and notification hook.
Ryan (console): Target: prototype in staging by EOD tomorrow, will ping DevEx for review.
Maria (platform): Thanks — I'll update the reprocess runbook with these guardrails and add an example CLI/API snippet for on-call. :thumbsup:
Alex: Quick command to inspect delta table counts (for folks running local queries):
```
SELECT count(*) FROM telemetry.delta_rp_42 WHERE event_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-09' AND '2026-03-10';
```
Sanjay: I'll draft the quota config PR and post here when ready.
Olivia: I'll add notify_emails and kms checks to the API schema.
Maria (platform): Great, closing here — thanks everyone. Will re-open if dry-run shows unexpected deltas. :eyes:
